domain.text: Software development delivery evidence for vmethod PR 58, covering watcher behavior and worker-path resolution.

impressions.text: The work addressed the closed-card report with two acceptance tests; both reproduced scenarios passed before production changes, so no closed-card production change was made.
The worker reported broad implementation and verification evidence, including 653 passing tests and a green check verdict.
The owner review said the watcher reports permission waits, failed turns, and stopped-without-reply once per stop, and avoids STALE after an already-reported failure.
The owner reported a live smoke found existing sessions through the unprefixed fallback and polled without errors; no live watcher smoke was claimed in the worker’s delivery evidence.
